body:
## Maintainer request — 2026-10-11

> An improvement issue would be not asking for a WiFi password on public networks that don’t ask for one

## Original behavior and accepted scope

The settled #318/D-UI-118 design asks for a key when an unsaved network row is chosen; saved networks use NetworkManager's stored profile. Retain those saved/connected/forget behaviors, but branch on the selected access point's advertised security for a new connection.

An open network that requires no Wi-Fi credential should connect without a Wi-Fi password modal. Protected networks still prompt appropriately; unknown/unsupported security must not be treated as open. A captive portal is a separate login after network association, not a Wi-Fi password; this request does not silently add a browser/portal feature.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Synthetic scan/NetworkManager fixtures and actual ES flow captures cover the branch and credential-preservation rules. No personal network/credential, physical radio action or owner-device test is necessary for implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Source-bound security classification distinguishes open, protected and unknown/unsupported scan records, including escaped SSIDs, with controls proving unknown security never bypasses the protected flow.
- [x] Choosing an unsaved open network reaches connection/progress/outcome without a Wi-Fi password prompt; backend argv contains no invented or stale password. A VM fixture and reviewed frame sequence prove the path.
- [x] Protected networks retain the password prompt and success/failure behavior; saved/connected/forget paths remain intact, verified with fixture assertions and affected branch frames. No existing stored credential is overwritten by a failed/open join.
- [x] docs/es-menu-map.md and canonical Wi-Fi IA/flow references include the open/protected/unknown branches, with exact-source EN/FR screenshots at640×480 and the larger supported QA size; current copy/translations and syntax/pin checks accompany the ES change.

Placement: M7.P5 under the maintainer's instruction “Let’s get all of the fixes and changes made, if we’ve tracked everything down”. Implement with #536/#537; preserve #318's saved/connected/forget contract. D-UI-125 remains binding.

## Current implementation — 2026-10-11 07:28 UTC

The isolated feature now checks advertised security before opening an editor. Open networks join without a password; protected/unknown networks retain the prompt. Saved profiles are matched by their actual SSID, including renamed profiles, and ambiguous multiple profiles require a choice. A callback lifetime defect found during that proof was corrected; its original AddressSanitizer failure and passing control are retained.

Actual ES VM walks passed English/French at640×480 and1280×800, including open success/failure, protected success/failure, unknown security, saved/connected/forget and multiple-profile paths. The original whole-flow matrix ended0 at07:35:48UTC; all16 driver jobs passed. The reviewed frame table and schema1 evidence-index.json are now linked from the canonical references. Canonical Wi-Fi flow/menu source is updated; proof lives in `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-network-cloud-management/`. Independent delta review, final evidence index and integration/pin checks remain; this is not a physical-radio or new-firmware claim.

## Verified source delivery — 2026-10-11T16:27:55.227775+00:00

Distribution [bc2dceb406](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/commit/bc2dceb406969a401d987de168acfb3ae60b7e01) and ES [c8dc72cf9e](https://github.com/pixelelated/emulationstation/commit/c8dc72cf9ec00ab00d6c4a9fcdcea1746c6f1f78) are integrated and pushed. Final delivery head `849e8dd3126a43f53abcae2678622c75ef85a08f` has successful exact-head hosted record and private-word checks. [Canonical flow/evidence packet](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/849e8dd3126a43f53abcae2678622c75ef85a08f/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-network-cloud-management); [independent audit, all seven repairs and Phase7 resolution](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/849e8dd3126a43f53abcae2678622c75ef85a08f/docs/audits/2026_10_11-epic-m7-network-cloud-344).

AC1–3: nine input/classification controls, 185 ES unit cases / 4,793 assertions, actual open/protected/unknown/saved/forget VM walks and the old-source/passing lifetime controls. AC4: reviewed WF01–WF07 EN/FR640/1280 frames, canonical menu/flow, syntax and published pin.

Only owned VM/local synthetic endpoints were used. The source fix is delivered; no new firmware image, owner-device update or personal-cloud action is claimed. Combined-image release qualification remains under #344/#537.
